headline: Whatever I've got has to last now. What's blocking my money?
note: Wired 2026-08-25 from fb-tarot/docs/writeups/shadow/REVIEW-money-alone-commit-2026-08-25.md — approved copy, transferred verbatim. Reuses the existing MONEY_TAROT_HOOKS frame; no new guard.

a: You turned the Magician. You couldn't see him, but your hand went to the worker of the three.
Both hands are busy above the table. Neither one is resting.
You asked what is blocking your money when what you have must last. The work on this card holds my attention.
The money is still blocked, and what you have must last.
What is holding the result leaves the work itself untouched. I don't think this began with you.
Let me look closer at what is holding the result…
b: You turned the Hanged Man. The cards were face down, and you found the one that's still growing.
Look at the wood above him. Green leaves are growing from it.
You asked what is blocking your money now. This card makes me stay with the living leaves inside the pause.
Still, the money has not moved. The pressure is on what you already have.
Something turns up just where the money should move. I don't think it started with you.
Let me see what that is…
c: You turned the Fool. The backs gave nothing away, but you chose the one travelling light.
Look at the small bundle on his stick. That's all he is carrying.
You asked what is blocking the money. What catches me is how little the Fool needs to carry.
And yet the money is blocked, while the bundle you have must be enough.
There's something between what you carry and what must last. I don't think it began with you.
Now let's look at what's there…
